getCodesForFamily

public java.lang.String[] getCodesForFamily(java.lang.String family,
                                            boolean userCodes)
Returns all the codes for a given family of signs.

If family is the empty string, will return all codes for all families. Note that tksesh user glyph codes won't be listed. (this could count as a bug).

Parameters:
family - : the Gardiner family for this sign (A,B...Aa,Ff)
Returns:
all codes for a given sign family.
